newsitem.title: USA: Dudley Moore files for divorce.
newsitem.headline: Dudley Moore files for divorce.

text.p: Comedian Dudley Moore's on-again, off-again marriage is off again.

The British-born star of the hit film "Arthur" filed for divorce from his wife Nicole in Los Angeles Superior Court on Tuesday on the grounds of irreconcilable differences after months of public spats and charges of spousal abuse.
In court papers, Moore said the paternity of the couple's two-year-old son, Nicholas, was in question and that there was a pending legal action to determine if he was the father.

The court action followed a reconciliation last month between the 62-year-old comedian and his 33-year-old fourth wife after she went on television and accused him of beating and terrorising her, making her take drugs and forcing her to dance for him in her underwear for up to 20 hours a day.
Nicole Moore filed a $10 million damages suit in May against her husband and announced plans to divorce him. He filed for divorce from her in 1996 but dropped that suit.

In her damages suit against Moore, Nicole Rothchild Moore alleged that he repeatedly pushed, hit and choked her. She also alleged that he forced her to take amphetamines that led to her suffering a stroke.
Her lawyer, Kenneth Chyten, said at the time of the suit that Moore "had a strange power he was able to exert over her."
Moore was arrested a month before the couple's April 1994 wedding for allegedly abusing her, but those charges were later dropped.
